cues: A bed about a metre square, stocked with a kilogram of worms.
Waste is pre digested for about twenty days, mixed with dung, kept moist and shaded.

After two to four months, not thirty days as often claimed, you harvest dark, odourless compost with about one percent nitrogen, twice that of farmyard manure, plus potassium, phosphorus, plant hormones and useful microbes.
